# Apps API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/api_reference.py from contracts/http; do not edit. -->

App packages, managed data, UI surfaces, Wasm extensions and the app builder. Contract version 1.0.0, generated from [`contracts/http/apps.openapi.json`](../../contracts/http/apps.openapi.json). 63 HTTP operations, 9 MCP tools. [All components](README.md) · [Build your first app](../build-your-first-app.md).

<div class="docs-try-config"></div>

## Set up a client

Every example below uses these three values. `VEYNDO_TOKEN` is needed only for merchant operations; keep it on your server.

```sh
export VEYNDO_URL=https://api.veyndo.ai
export VEYNDO_SHOP=<your-shop-id>
export VEYNDO_TOKEN=<personal-session-or-integration-key>
```

<div class="docs-examples" markdown="1">

<p class="docs-example-label">curl</p>

```sh
curl -fsS "$VEYNDO_URL/health"
```

<p class="docs-example-label">TypeScript</p>

```typescript
import { Auth, VeyndoClient } from "@veyndo/commerce-client";

const client = new VeyndoClient({
  baseUrl: process.env.VEYNDO_URL!,
  tenant: process.env.VEYNDO_SHOP,
  auth: process.env.VEYNDO_TOKEN ? Auth.personalSession(process.env.VEYNDO_TOKEN) : undefined,
});
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Python</p>

```python
import os
from veyndo_sdk import Auth, VeyndoClient

token = os.environ.get("VEYNDO_TOKEN")
client = VeyndoClient(os.environ["VEYNDO_URL"], tenant=os.environ["VEYNDO_SHOP"],
                      auth=Auth.personal_session(token) if token else None)
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Rust</p>

```rust
use serde_json::json;
use veyndo_sdk::{Auth, Client, ClientOptions, RequestOptions};

let client = Client::new(ClientOptions {
    base_url: std::env::var("VEYNDO_URL")?,
    tenant: std::env::var("VEYNDO_SHOP").ok(),
    auth: std::env::var("VEYNDO_TOKEN").ok().map(Auth::PersonalSession),
    ..ClientOptions::default()
});
```

</div>

The `apps` API object, method names and argument order are those of the generated [SDKs](../sdks.md).

## Merchant HTTP

Each route checks the named permission against your current membership.

## MCP tools

Called with JSON-RPC `tools/call` on `POST /mcp`. The facts come from the [typed operations graph](../business-capabilities.md#the-typed-operations-graph); the server validates the input schema before it runs a tool.

### `developer.archive` {: #tool-developer-archive }

Explicit recoverable App Studio project removal or restore.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Audience | merchant |
| Writes | yes |
| Risk | low |
| Reversibility | reversible |
| Requires approval | no |
| Cost | standard |
| Permissions | `developer.manage` |
| Effects | none |
| Conditions | none |
| Data | app |
| Requires | none |

| Argument | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app` | string | yes |
| `approve` | boolean | yes |
| `archived` | boolean | yes |

<p class="docs-try-note">A write. Not executed from the docs. Try it in a <a href="../build-your-first-app.md#deploy-to-a-private-sandbox">private sandbox</a>.</p>

<div class="docs-examples" markdown="1">

<p class="docs-example-label">curl</p>

```sh
curl -fsS -X POST "$VEYNDO_URL/mcp" \
  -H "x-tenant: $VEYNDO_SHOP" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $VEYNDO_TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "developer.archive", "arguments": {"app": "<string>", "archived": false, "approve": false}}}'
```

<p class="docs-example-label">TypeScript</p>

```typescript
const result = await client.mcp.call("developer.archive", {"app": "<string>", "archived": false, "approve": false});
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Python</p>

```python

```

<p class="docs-example-label">Rust</p>

```rust
let result = client.mcp().call_raw("developer.archive", json!({"app": "<string>", "archived": false, "approve": false})).await?;
```

</div>


### `merchant.apps.read` {: #tool-merchant-apps-read }

Read an explicitly discovered managed app model through its current declared read action.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Audience | merchant |
| Writes | no |
| Risk | low |
| Reversibility | reversible |
| Requires approval | no |
| Cost | provider |
| Permissions | `apps.read` |
| Effects | externalCall |
| Conditions | none |
| Data | app |
| Requires | `merchant.apps.search` |

| Argument | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | string (max length 160) | yes |
| `app` | string (max length 160) | yes |
| `arguments` | object | yes |

<p class="docs-try-note">Needs a merchant credential. Run it against your own <a href="../build-your-first-app.md#deploy-to-a-private-sandbox">private sandbox</a>.</p>

<div class="docs-examples" markdown="1">

<p class="docs-example-label">curl</p>

```sh
curl -fsS -X POST "$VEYNDO_URL/mcp" \
  -H "x-tenant: $VEYNDO_SHOP" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $VEYNDO_TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "merchant.apps.read", "arguments": {"app": "<string>", "action": "<string>", "arguments": {}}}}'
```

<p class="docs-example-label">TypeScript</p>

```typescript
const result = await client.mcp.call("merchant.apps.read", {"app": "<string>", "action": "<string>", "arguments": {}});
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Python</p>

```python
result = client.mcp.call("merchant.apps.read", {"app": "<string>", "action": "<string>", "arguments": {}})
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Rust</p>

```rust
let result = client.mcp().call_raw("merchant.apps.read", json!({"app": "<string>", "action": "<string>", "arguments": {}})).await?;
```

</div>

### `merchant.apps.search` {: #tool-merchant-apps-search }

Find relevant installed apps and their admitted read tools by query; follow nextAfter.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Audience | merchant |
| Writes | no |
| Risk | low |
| Reversibility | reversible |
| Requires approval | no |
| Cost | free |
| Permissions | `apps.read` |
| Effects | none |
| Conditions | none |
| Data | app |
| Requires | none |

| Argument | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `after` | string (max length 160) | no |
| `limit` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 20) | no |
| `query` | string (max length 4000) | no |

<p class="docs-try-note">Needs a merchant credential. Run it against your own <a href="../build-your-first-app.md#deploy-to-a-private-sandbox">private sandbox</a>.</p>

<div class="docs-examples" markdown="1">

<p class="docs-example-label">curl</p>

```sh
curl -fsS -X POST "$VEYNDO_URL/mcp" \
  -H "x-tenant: $VEYNDO_SHOP" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $VEYNDO_TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "merchant.apps.search", "arguments": {"limit": 3}}}'
```

<p class="docs-example-label">TypeScript</p>

```typescript
const result = await client.mcp.call("merchant.apps.search", {"limit": 3});
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Python</p>

```python
result = client.mcp.call("merchant.apps.search", {"limit": 3})
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Rust</p>

```rust
let result = client.mcp().call_raw("merchant.apps.search", json!({"limit": 3})).await?;
```

</div>
